critique: The interface achieves strong functional clarity through its logical grouping of harmony presets and color properties, but the visual hierarchy is undermined by inconsistent spacing and alignment—particularly the awkward gap between the color wheel and piano keyboard. While the color wheel's centered prominence creates good visual flow, the flat treatment of interactive elements (preset buttons and piano keys) lacks the dimensional cues needed to communicate their clickability, creating a disconnect between the sophisticated color visualization and the utilitarian controls.
